title: On the Energy Dissipation in the Landau-Lifshitz-Gilbert Equation
summary: The dynamics of magnetization near a stable equilibrium in ferromagnetic nanomagnets are examined within the Landau--Lifshitz--Gilbert (LLG) framework. For a small angle precession, the dependence of ferromagnetic resonance (FMR) frequency, the damping constant and the resulting quality factor $Q$ of the resonance on the local curvature around the free-energy minimum is systematically analyzed.
